# vismi

The R package **vismi** ([Visual Diagnostics for Multiple
Imputation](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/)) provides a
comprehensive suite of visual diagnostics for assessing the quality of
multiply imputed data. The package supports imputed data generated by
various multiple imputation methods, including `mixgb`, `mice`, and
more.

## Overview

The package has been completely redesigned. Please check **Articles**
section for more details.

- [`vismi()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/vismi.md):
  visualise multiply-imputed missing data through distributional
  characteristics

- [`vismi_overimp()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/vismi_overimp.md):
  visualise multiply-imputed missing data through overimputation

- [`vismi_converge()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/vismi_converge.md):
  visualise convergence diagnostics for imputed values of an incomplete
  variable

With the support of
[trelliscopejs](https://hafen.github.io/trelliscopejs/), **vismi**
provides trelliscope displays to inspect all variables at once via

- [`trellis_vismi()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/trellis_vismi.md)

- [`trellis_vismi_overimp()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/trellis_vismi_overimp.md)

- [`trellis_vismi_converge()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/trellis_vismi_converge.md)

## Installation

You can install the current development version of vismi from
[GitHub](https://github.com/agnesdeng) with:

``` r
devtools::install_github("agnesdeng/vismi")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`imp_newborn`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/imp_newborn.md)
  : Precomputed mixgb imputed datasets for \`newborn\`
- [`imp_nhanes3`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/imp_nhanes3.md)
  : Precomputed mixgb imputed datasets for \`nhanes3\`
- [`newborn`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/newborn.md) :
  NHANES III (1988-1994) newborn data
- [`nhanes3`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/nhanes3.md) :
  A small subset of the NHANES III (1988-1994) newborn data
- [`overimp()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/overimp.md)
  : Overimpute main function
- [`print(`*`<vismi>`*`)`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/print.vismi.md)
  : print method for vismi objects
- [`trellis_vismi()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/trellis_vismi.md)
  : Trelliscope Visualisation of Distributional Characteristics
- [`trellis_vismi_converge()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/trellis_vismi_converge.md)
  : Trelliscope Visualisation of Convergence Diagnostics
- [`trellis_vismi_overimp()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/trellis_vismi_overimp.md)
  : Trelliscope Visualisation of Overimputation Diagnostics
- [`vismi()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/vismi.md) :
  Visualise Multiple Imputations Through Distributional Characteristics
- [`vismi_converge()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/vismi_converge.md)
  : Visualise convergence diagnostics
- [`vismi_overimp()`](https://agnesdeng.github.io/vismi/reference/vismi_overimp.md)
  : Visualise Multiple Imputation Through Overimputation
